name: sdd-hybrid
description: Spec-driven development workflow with UI/UX design automation: Brainstorm (with deep research) -> Constitution -> Plan (with 20 design template selection) -> Build (with auto asset generation, background removal, and ReactBits integration) -> Review -> Security (OWASP Top 10:2025). A project-wide constitution gates every step, and a security review gates every push to CI/CD.
